tool_input.command: grep -rn "resource:" -r . --include="*.ts" --exclude-dir=node_modules | head -30; echo ---; find / -maxdepth 6 -iname "@guren" -type d 2>/dev/null; echo ---; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -name "*.ts" -print | xargs grep -l "RouteContractOptions" 2>/dev/null

cat > /tmp/debug-test.ts <<'EOF'
import { TestApp } from '@guren/testing'
import app from './src/app.js'
import { resetDatabase } from './config/database.js'
import { Post } from './app/Models/Post.js'
import { User } from './app/Models/User.js'

await resetDatabase()
const http = await TestApp.fromApp(app)
const alice = await User.create({ name: 'Alice', email: 'alice@example.com', password: 'secret123' })
await Post.forceCreate({ title: 'First', excerpt: 'e1', body: 'b1', authorId: alice.id })

const res = await http.get('/api/posts')
console.log(res.status)
console.log(await res.text())
EOF
NODE_ENV=test bun run /tmp/debug-test.ts 2>&1 | tail -60
